notable: Site errors in the work years: 'Huckleberry Finn (1882)' (published 1884/85) and 'The Prince and the Pauper (1882)' (published 1881). It also spells 'Life on the Mississipi'. There are no birth or death dates on the page.

label: Arab Encyclopedia concept ID
missing: Nothing substantial. The bio, 17 works, places, the bibliography and the volume/page are captured. The page also mentions the 1870 marriage and the deaths of his wife and daughters (no names), which the profile does not capture.
label_issues: Minor: related_agent includes 'ممدوح عدوان / Mamdouh Adwan (author of the article)'. He wrote the article and has no relation to Twain. field_of_activity 'الآداب الجرمانية' (Germanic literatures) is the site's own classification, captured as given.
notable: Site errors: it says he worked 'with his father as a sailor on a river boat on the Mississippi' (his father died in 1847, and Twain was a pilot) and that he spent 'six years in California'. It dates The Mysterious Stranger to 1906 (published 1916).

label: Harper's tag
wrong_values: name_preferred 'Mark Twain Archives | Harper's Magazine' (HTML page title, with an unescaped entity)
image 'https://wp.harpers.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/harpers-d-1500x500-1.jpeg' (generic site banner, per the extraction note)
type 'http://schema.org/CollectionPage' and 'http://schema.org/BreadcrumbList' (page-structure types, not entity data)
missing: The tag archive has 9 pages ('1 2 3 … 9'), and only page 1 was captured. Pages 2-9 of pieces by and about Twain are missing. Only 4 Twain-authored titles came through: Dreamland, Humor, Sitting in darkness, Copyright piracy, circa 1872. This is the 'page 1 only' class of error, well under the 40-title cap.
label_issues: format_family 'RDF' is misleading. The JSON-LD only declares a CollectionPage/BreadcrumbList, and every value about him comes from page text or the og:title. It should be 'page text (LLM)', or at most embedded markup for the title. uniqueness_bucket 'mostly unique (>60%)' is inflated by the chrome values (page title, banner URL, page types). domain 'government-other' is odd for a magazine.
notable: This is a magazine tag page, not an authority record. It has no bio, and it mixes pieces by Twain with pieces about him (Sullivan, Lapham, Carroll, a Carl Jensen letter).

name_preferred and description 'How tall was Mark Twain?' (FAQ question schema, not a name)

missing: Height 5'9" (1.75 m) is the site's one distinctive fact and is not in the profile (no schema element for it). The 'Related Collections' (Creatives, Arts & Sciences, History…) are also missing, though these are minor.

notable: Site errors: the description spells the name 'Samuel Langhorne Clemen' and lists 'The Great American Novel' as one of his works (it is an epithet for Huck Finn). Birthday November 30, 1835 and death April 21, 1910 are correct.
